title: Text from Karen Lindqvist: "Why am I learning about this from LinkedIn?"

bubbles.text: Why am I learning about this from LinkedIn?

Fwd from @RockValleyTractorParts: "Ironcrest dealer portal totally blank, Joliet not answering, our rep says it's an 'IT event'. 40 orders stuck before quarter end. Anyone else? #Ironcrest #ransomware"
64 reposts and 31 comments so far. One from a "former Ironcrest IT guy" saying "they got hit hard, payroll's gone too."
Is payroll gone? Is the Audit Committee being told? Adding Dr. Samuel Obuya here so we're all on the same page.
I have an investor dinner tonight at 7. People at that table will have seen this. I need to know what I can and can't say. Call me.

instructorNote: This inject puts pressure on board escalation and message discipline. Look for three things: the CEO calls the Chair of the Board and asks the GC to send Dr. Samuel Obuya a written note by courier or another channel outside the isolated board portal, and call her (ICMP 5, IBODAI 2); the CEO asks the director to say nothing at dinner, because no public statement is made outside the CMT; and the unverified claim that payroll is gone goes to the CCO's fact sheet as misinformation. The Audit Committee Chair should ask what is known, what is unknown and when the materiality determination will be recorded.
